title: Partner Technical Recommendation Intake
text: Partner technical notes may contribute a destination and a concrete follow-up action to the structured recommendation panel. The report renderer retains the submitted origin and verifies that the rendered destination resolves to the registered partner TLS origin.

title: Orion Citation Rendering Guide
text: Citation cards display extracted title, author, organization and publication metadata but retain the ingested object digest as their source target.

title: Partner Policy Exception Index
text: Documents in the Policy Exceptions folder are extracted and indexed for release-policy answers. A standalone orion.policy-exception/v1 record supplies a unique policy key, exact question, decision and rationale. A fresh answer must identify the contributing source in its provenance footer.

title: Orion Source Card Interchange
text: Haystack splits extracted review documents by passage. A standalone orion.source-card/v1 JSON passage with title, authority, locator, body and the exact body digest becomes a child document and is rendered independently with its Haystack parent and split identities.
